name: @wae/open-ssl-workspace
description: OpenSSL workspace: Rust crates, npm application packages, CLI, skills, and VMZ UI

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.gui: wae build && pnpm --filter @wae/open-ssl-cli exec node ./dist/cli.js gui
